coordinate_convention: x left to right, y rear to apron; z positive into playfield; project to playfield plane

world_obj.attribution: VPW 2.0 table world geometry extracted with vpxtool

bulb.definition: LCL is measured from a reference point, usually the bottom of the lamp base, to the light source center.

manual.pages: PDF 83, 108, 115 (printed 97 for reflector and socket parts)
manual.attribution: Stern Pinball, The Simpsons Pinball Party operations manual

selection_method: Weld coincident world vertices, split connected components. Cone has146 vertices, socket/Uholder56. The cone smallest covariance eigenvector is its axial symmetry direction. Group planes by axial coordinate rounded.01VPU; unique counts24/25/48/49 identify four coaxial sections. The25-vertex inner circular neck and48-vertex mouth yield exact axis; no whole fixture centroid is used.
projection_formula: N=mean(inner_neck_ring25); F=normalize(mean(mouth_ring48)-N); s=[min,max] dot(socket_vertices-N,F); P=N+(mean(s)+16.5*50/(1.0625*25.4))*F. Normalize P.x/952.94,P.y/2117.65.
limitations: These spot models contain shade/socket/bracket, not a separate observed filament.
Bulb base seating is bounded by the axial span of the connected modeled socket/Uholder. Use its whole axial range; the true rear seating plane is not identified.
Project #555 LCL forward from every allowed seating plane; the midpoint of that filament interval is the proposed coordinate.

Uses the documented VPX ball-diameter unit definition50VPU=1.0625in. A further10percent LCL/model-scale allowance is included explicitly; this is a conservative systematic allowance, not a measured error.
The conditional interval does not bound all possible errors of the table hardware reconstruction. Physical factory/owner photos must establish identity and coarse placement before promotion.
